text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, so employees can focus on more interesting work. Productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help people save time and work more efficiently. Many companies also encourage human-AI collaboration, where workers and AI systems solve problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, and workers will need to learn new skills. Overall, AI can make work faster and easier, but it is important for employees to adapt and keep learning.
